How TTMS powers Load Planning

Operationally practical capabilities inspired by modern fleet technology teams and tailored for transport businesses.

  • Load building tools tied to real fleet and trailer availability
  • Weight, cube, and equipment compatibility checks
  • Pickup-drop sequencing based on service windows and risk factors
  • Automated assignment suggestions with HOS and lane awareness
  • Customer-level planning templates for repeat shipment profiles
  • Plan-to-actual visibility for missed assumptions and recovery actions

User Safety & Care

We care for customers, drivers, and owners by turning day-to-day fleet execution into safer, clearer, and less stressful workflows.

  • Balanced load plans prevent last-minute high-pressure assignments
  • Compliance checks reduce unsafe overloading or mismatch scenarios
  • Driver-ready instructions lower confusion at shipper and receiver sites
  • Proactive updates improve customer confidence and operational calm

Hardware & Anti-Theft for TTMS

Connected ELD Compliance

Load Planning stays compliant with real-time ELD logs, HOS visibility, and inspection-ready records.

Audit & Compliance Reporting

Load Planning data feeds TTMS reporting automatically so teams can prepare regulator-facing and owner-facing reviews with less manual effort.

  • Load Planning events are captured with timestamps and operational context for cleaner audit trails.
  • ELD, AI DashCam, and GPS records support compliance reporting without fragmented manual collection.
  • Owners can review KPI, exception, and safety logs in one TTMS - Total Transport Management System workflow.
  • Teams generate regulator-ready and customer-facing reports with accurate, centralized data.
